findings.description: The bucket is explicitly noted as public with no bucket ACL or public access block restricting access, allowing anyone to read or write objects including the customer-master.xlsx file stored in it.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects (including sensitive customer data) are stored unencrypted at rest.
Versioning is not enabled, so accidental or malicious deletion/overwrite of objects in this sensitive, publicly exposed bucket cannot be recovered.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in public unencrypted storage
findings.description: A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, exposing potentially sensitive customer PII to unauthenticated access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is set for this bucket holding financial data, leaving stored objects unencrypted.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so objects in this bucket are stored without encryption at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, so data science data is stored unencrypted despite having logging and versioning configured.
